title: Bendigo Bank Ready Credit Card
body:
O.P.
this post was edited
Seems like a new offer from Bendigo Bank.
https://www.bendigobank.com. au/personal/credit-cards/ready/
No Annual Fee No International Transaction Fee Travel Insurance 18 months 0% on Purchases
No rewards etc to speak of. This seems to match Bankwest Zero Platinum (a quick glance through the Insurance information seems like it might even be better... for instance, it offers car Rental Excess Insurance).
Anybody got one/applied/any thoughts? Considering applying for one as it might be handy to have.

---- replies ----
[User #6970262071 postsfiveferrariWhirlpool Forums Addict] What a bummer timing. I just got 28 Degrees card as my travel credit card. I would have gotten this instead.
[User #75874533 postssm1DDyWhirlpool Enthusiast] Compared to BankWest the only thing it seems to lack is the ability to split large purchases over four months.
[User #6435613488 postsMugsyEnhance your calm!Whirlpool Forums Addict] Just found out about this. Seems like a great alternative to Bankwest... 28 degrees still has the advantage of the free wifi/roaming data.
More discussions here: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/742184
[User #844508609 postsausslavWhirlpool Enthusiast] Just chanced upon this new credit card which could be useful for my Netflix/Youtube TR subs.
Any user reviews on it so far comparing it to Bankwest zero plat card regarding domestic/international Travel Insurance, Extended Warranty, Purchase Protection ? Thanks.
[User #844508609 postsausslavWhirlpool Enthusiast] User Mugsy posted this in another thread, shared here with thanks: There's a few differences:
Bankwest: - travel insurance only covers 31 consecutive days - maximum 1yr extended warranty - has 30 days price guarantee if item drops $75 with claim maxing out at $1000
Bendigo - travel insurance covers 90 consecutive days and looks to have coverage for covid - maximum 2yrs extended warranty - no price guarantee
I haven't examined the travel insurance coverage and limits in detail yet... I'm actually more concerned about comparing to third party travel insurance providers who have good covid coverage.
[User #251835720 postsjp87PSN: thejamie_pWhirlpool Enthusiast] For those that applied for this card as a new Bendigo bank customer. How long did it take them to verify your payslips once the docs are uploaded?
[User #392904236 postsGrahamMusic marks timeWhirlpool Forums Addict] jp87 writes...
How long did it take them to verify your payslips once the docs are uploaded?
2 days.
[User #648374856 postsnagelWhirlpool Enthusiast] Does Bendigo send Verification SMS or is it all in app? Going overseas soon and will be using a local data sim (no dual sim phone) so won't receive SMS.
[User #392904236 postsGrahamMusic marks timeWhirlpool Forums Addict] The card can't be added to Google wallet on your watch, but it can be added to Google wallet on your phone.
[User #844508609 postsausslavWhirlpool Enthusiast] Graham writes...
The card can't be added to Google wallet on your watch
That's a shame, does anyone knows why it can do phone but not watch? Any difference in NFC?
[User #6454672963 postsE5TOQUEWhirlpool Forums Addict] nagel writes...
oes Bendigo send Verification SMS or is it all in app? Going overseas soon and will be using a local data sim (no dual sim phone) so won't receive SMS.
From memory they use a Symantec VIP Access app. Its a separate 2FA app outside the Bendigo Bank app. So assuming that is connected to your phone before you leave, that should cover you.
They have online chat on their website, just ask them. Or call them to confirm.
[User #36647611762 postsPikey18Send complaints to /dev/nullWhirlpool Forums Addict] Considering this card to replace 28 degrees.
Does anyone know if they support taking the full statement balance as a direct debit from an account elsewhere (in my case ubank)?
It’s how I have 28 degrees set up and I love everything being automated.
[User #80207251 postsjmpow2Participant] I just replaced my Bankwest Platinum with this card. I've not found what you're looking for, at least online. I've always paid my statement balance in full too, with bpay manually, and was very pleasantly surprised to discover payments from my uBank account are instant/Osko to this card! (much more comfortable with a lower cc limit if I can repay it instantly)
[User #1718712267 postsRemorhazAUWhirlpool Forums Addict] ausslav writes...
Bankwest: - travel insurance only covers 31 consecutive days - maximum 1yr extended warranty - has 30 days price guarantee if item drops $75 with claim maxing out at $1000
Does anyone know if Bankwest Zero has the extended warranty and price protection anymore? I can't see anything about it on the Bankwest site?
[User #6435613488 postsMugsyEnhance your calm!Whirlpool Forums Addict] Wiillson writes...
Better still, Bendigo offer a dedicated RSA keyfob.
Definitely getting this card as my main credit card.
I got my 60k velocity points from the Citibank Rewards promo and need to cancel all credit cards again as we look like we need to reapply for our construction loan. So it'll be Bendigo as my next credit card.
